$Comment: The library's sample boost for its sample track, switched off like the track: turn both on (tracks.json { "Zc_Track_Example": { "Enabled": true } } and boosts.json { "Zc_Boost_Example": { "Enabled": true } }) and /zigboost start --boost=Zc_Boost_Example gives the player half as much again on the sample track for 30 minutes, shown as a tile on their buff bar. One may run at a time, and a player waits an hour between starts.
